description: Defines the RenderTargetCache template class used for caching rendering targets in different graphics back-ends (D3D9, D3D11, Vulkan). It manages updates and retrieval of framebuffer attachment render targets.

classes.name: RenderTargetCache
classes.description: A template class for caching framebuffer render targets across different graphics back-ends, supporting update and retrieval operations.

methods.name: RenderTargetCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache pointers to null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates all render targets based on framebuffer dirty bits.

methods.name: updateReadColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the read color render target.

methods.name: updateColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates a specific color attachment render target.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns the array of color render targets.

methods.name: getColorDraw
methods.description: Returns the color render target for drawing at a specific index.

methods.name: getColorRead
methods.description: Returns the color render target for reading.
